description:
Build physical AI applications with real robot arms @ Viam! About the Event
 We're excited to host a two-day, hands-on hackathon for curious, ambitious builders who want to go deep on physical AI. You'll get a real robot arm and support from Viam experts throughout.
 No prior robotics experience is required, just an interest in physical AI and some software experience.
 Space is limited! Apply through this page. Applicants will be accepted on a rolling basis. What You'll Build
 Working in a team of 2-3, you'll build an end-to-end robotics application using Viam and a real robot arm. Each team will have access to:
 UFactory xArm or Universal Robots arm with a two-finger gripper attachment (feel free to also bring your own SO-101)

 Linux compute machine

 RealSense D435 or Orbbec Astra 2 camera (fixed to arm)

 Webcams

 A free Viam account

 We'll provide blocks, cups, pens, paper, and other objects for your robot to interact with, or bring something you'd like to experiment with.
 Please bring your own laptop.
 Challenges
 Accepted participants can select from predefined projects or bring your own idea.
 1) Benchmark ideas: pick one of five tasks and get scored on it.
 Charger plugging: Sub-centimeter precision, occlusion at the moment of contact

 Pouring liquid into a cup: Continuous control; a spill is a visible failure

 Recycling sort: Perception in clutter

 Egg transfer: Force control; failure is unambiguous and dramatic

 Jenga pull: Precision plus force feedback; the tower falling ends your run

 2) Open: bring your own idea and get judged on ambition and execution.
 Ideas from past events: playing chess, mixing a cocktail, quality inspection, drawing a picture, puzzle insertion, setting a table, folding clothes.

name: Trust in the Hiring Funnel Hackathon @ NYU
description:
Event Description
 Generative AI broke hiring on both sides at once. Recruiters can't tell which applicants are real, and candidates can't tell which employers are. Come spend a day building something that fixes it - with the founders, engineers, and TA practitioners who live this problem every week.
 This is a full-day, in-person hackathon co-hosted by localhost:nyc, Integral Recruiting (IRD), and NYU - where builders team up with real talent-acquisition operators to ship working tools against a single, focused challenge.
 The Challenge: Trust in the Hiring Funnel
 Hiring has a trust crisis on both sides of the funnel - recruiters can't tell which applicants are real, and candidates can't tell which employers are. Talent acquisition runs on a basic assumption: that the person applying is who they say they are, and that the company reaching out is who it says it is. Generative AI has broken both halves of that assumption at once. Your job for the day is to rebuild it.
 You can attack either side of the funnel - or the seam between them.
 Side A - Trust coming in: the applicant flood. A role that used to draw 30 applicants now draws 500, and a growing share aren't real, aren't qualified, or are gaming the system. Candidates embed hidden prompt-injection text to manipulate the AI tools that screen resumes. And increasingly, applicants appear qualified but look strikingly alike - the same phrasing, the same structure, the same accomplishments - a tell that everyone is leaning on the same AI tools to write their applications. Recruiters are drowning, and the tools meant to help have no clear winner yet.

We're especially interested in spaces where people share not only from their own experience, but in how they relate to the experiences of others. Through reflective dialogue and other group tools, we hope to deepen and enrich how we all communicate and process together.
 Food and the belly are their own complex questions for moms.

9:45 - 10:30 am | Session 1: From Testimony to Accountability: A UN Framework Protocol on CRSV

Moderator: Tatiana Kotlyarenko, Member of IF20 Advisory Group on Human Trafficking

Despite a robust body of international humanitarian, human rights and criminal law addressing conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), a persistent gap remains between international commitments and their effective implementation at the national level. This high-level panel will examine the case for a United Nations Framework Protocol on the Implementation of International Obligations relating to Conflict-Related Sexual Violence and Survivor-Centred Responses, a practical framework designed not to create new legal obligations, but to help States translate existing commitments into effective prevention, reporting and documentation, national response frameworks, justice and accountability, comprehensive referral mechanisms, and long-term support for victims and survivors. Building on existing international standards and good practices, including the Murad Code, the discussion will consider how a Framework Protocol could strengthen survivor-centred and trauma-informed approaches, national coordination and international cooperation, while addressing emerging challenges and opportunities related to digital evidence, artificial intelligence and responsible innovation. The panel will bring together experts to identify priority implementation gaps and launch a global consultation process towards the development of the Framework Protocol.

Fawzia Koofi, President, Women for Afghanistan

Céline Bardet, Founder and President, We are NOT Weapons of War (WWoW)

Jay Rosenzweig, CEO, Rosenzweig & Company; Honorary Chair, Raoul Wallenberg Centre for Human Rights; Senior Fellow, Munk School of Global Affairs & Public Policy

Mandy Sanghera, International Human Rights Advocate

10:30 am - 10:45 | Session 2: Fireside Chat | Developing a standard for human dignity

name: Superpollutant Action Summit
description:
Beyond Alliance convenes the Superpollutant Action Summit as a first-of-its-kind, full-day forum for senior leaders from business, science, government, and civil society. The goal is to speed up action on the pollutants that most affect near-term warming: methane, black carbon, nitrous oxide (N₂O), and hydrofluorocarbons (HFCs).

Strong cuts over the next decade could noticeably shift the warming curve before mid-century. Organizers describe superpollutant mitigation as one of the fastest, most practical climate levers available, with clear co-benefits for air quality and public health.

Momentum has been building across governments, companies, and civil society - from the Global Methane Pledge to corporate programs such as the Superpollutant Action Initiative. That $100 million initiative, supported by Amazon, Autodesk, Figma, Google, JPMorgan Chase, Salesforce, and Workday and coordinated by Beyond Alliance, backs high-impact mitigation projects.

The summit is expected to draw more than 150 decision-makers from business, finance, policy, and innovation. Programming includes deep dives on corporate Scope 3 emissions, emerging market mechanisms, voluntary carbon markets, and the policies and financing required to scale solutions - structured for frank dialogue and tangible commitments.

Across the day, expect plenary sessions where science, policy, and capital intersect; themed breakouts; discussions on what it will take to finance faster action at scale; and a showcase of solutions from innovators and project developers.

In fact, research from Topo Finance found that, for many of the world's largest companies, the emissions generated by their cash and investments exceeded all their other emissions combined: their operations, their products, even their AI.
 We have an opportunity to change that. By leveraging our financial management, we can drive positive impact and help transform the financial system into a visible hand for environmental and social progress around the world.

name: WoCS Austin X Cloudflare: The Forward Deployed Era + CS's Shift to Revenue
description:
About Event

 That is the real shift, and it is what this evening is about. When technical delivery is no longer how you prove your value, that value has to show up somewhere else, and more and more that somewhere is the number: the renewal, the expansion, the growth of the account. So the questions get practical fast. What do you hand off? What do you hold onto? And how do you build the language and instincts of someone who owns revenue, even if your title does not say so yet?
 This time you'll hear from both sides of that handoff: a Forward Deployed Engineer who can tell you exactly what the role owns and why it exists, and a senior Cloudflare Customer Success leader whose team recently brought FDEs into the org, so she has lived what changes for CS when that work moves. name: Bitcoin 101 for Developers & Curious Beginners | Andheri, Mumbai
description:
How does Bitcoin work without a bank or a central server? And what actually happens when you send a bitcoin transaction?
Join Bitshala for a beginner-friendly workshop exploring how Bitcoin works under the hood. We'll break down the key ideas in simple language, follow a transaction through the network, and guide you through creating and sending one yourself.

You'll use Bitcoin's test network, so you can experiment without using real bitcoin. No prior coding or Bitcoin knowledge required.
AGENDA:
Keys, addresses, and ownership: What a Bitcoin wallet does, how addresses work, and how you prove you can spend your bitcoin.
How transactions work: How Bitcoin tracks individual pieces of bitcoin rather than a bank-style account balance, and how those pieces get spent and combined.
A transaction's journey: What happens after you hit "send," how computers on the network check your transaction, and where it waits before being included in a block.
Blocks and mining: How transactions are grouped into blocks, what miners do, and how the network agrees on a shared transaction history.
Bitcoin's incentives and supply: Why miners earn rewards and fees, what a "halving" means, and how Bitcoin's 21 million supply limit works.
Hands-on practice: With step-by-step guidance, build, sign, and send a transaction on Bitcoin's test network.
WHO'S GUIDING
Led by the Bitshala Contributors. We are a community of Bitcoin developers and educators.
WHAT TO EXPECT
Level: Beginner-friendly.
Format: An interactive workshop with explanations, room for questions, and a guided transaction exercise.
Bring: A laptop and your curiosity.
Experience needed: None. You don't need to know how to code.
IS THIS FOR YOU?
This workshop is for you if you:
Have used a Bitcoin wallet and wondered what happens behind the scenes.
Are a developer looking for a starting point with Bitcoin.
Are new to Bitcoin and prefer learning by doing.
Want to understand how a network can work without one company running it.
Leave with a clearer picture of how Bitcoin works, and a test-network transaction you created yourself.

To connect with Bitcoiners in Mumbai, join the Signal group

About Bitshala
Bitshala is a Bitcoin-focused education initiative where we help developers, designers, and curious builders learn by doing. We run cohorts, clubs, workshops, a hackerspace, and community programs that make it easier for people to explore, contribute to, and build on Bitcoin. name: Bitcoin Wallets: Keys, Transactions, and the Mempool | Chandigarh
description:
When you click "Send," your wallet doesn't transfer money, it broadcasts a cryptographic signature directly to a global, ownerless network.
Join us for a deep dive into the inner workings of Bitcoin wallets! Whether you're a developer, a curious Bitcoiner, or someone wanting to understand what happens under the hood when you click "Send," this meetup is for you.

We will break down how wallets manage your secret keys, how transactions are constructed and signed, and how they navigate the mempool to reach finality on the blockchain.
AGENDA
Public vs. Private Keys: How cryptographic key pairs prove ownership.
Seed Phrases & HD Wallets: How 12 to 24 words can restore all your funds across multiple addresses.
Key Management Best Practices: Hot wallets vs. Cold storage and multisig setups.
UTXO Model: How Bitcoin tracks ownership using Unspent Transaction Outputs instead of balance accounts.
Transaction Anatomy: Inputs, Outputs, ScriptPubKey, and Digital Signatures.
Fee Estimation & RBF: Understanding mining fees and Replace-By-Fee (RBF) mechanics.
What is the Mempool?: How nodes receive, validate, and queue unconfirmed transactions.
Fee Rates & Priority: How miners select transactions based on satoshis per vByte (sat/vB).
Congestion & Confirmation: What happens during high-traffic periods and how to navigate stuck transactions.
WHO'S GUIDING
Led by Bitshala educators and open-source builders. Our sessions are led by active community members who build open-source tools, study the Bitcoin protocol, and advocate for transparent, open software.
WHAT TO EXPECT
Difficulty: Beginner level. Designed for absolute newcomers.
Zero Fluff: No sales pitches, no trading talk, and no corporate slides. Just pure peer-to-peer technical literacy.
IS THIS FOR YOU?
You are curious about how money and technology intersect.
You want to understand how Bitcoin works under the hood rather than follow market trends.
You prefer clear, logical explanations over complex jargon.
You enjoy asking foundational questions in a welcoming, hands-on environment.
Coding experience not required. Intellectual curiosity about peer-to-peer technology is.
You will leave this session with a clear, grounded understanding of how value travels from a local secret key to permanent block confirmation.

We run cohorts, clubs, workshops, a hackerspace, and community programs that make it easier for people to explore, contribute to, and build on Bitcoin. name: Claude for Blockchain: Trading Agents
description:
Pre-TOKEN2049 edition - Claude Singapore Community
 In March, OKX did something no major exchange had done: they open-sourced a toolkit that lets an AI agent trade directly on their platform. Spot, futures, options, grid bots - 80+ tools, MIT licensed, running locally on your machine.
 Most of the industry still hasn't looked at it.
 This session is a straight, practical hour on what exchange-native AI trading actually is, what it can and can't do, and what it means for how you work.
 What we'll cover
 What OKX actually shipped. The Agent Trade Kit, how it plugs into Claude Code through MCP, and the real scope of what an agent can reach - market data, order execution, position management, automated strategies.
 The security model, honestly. Your API keys stay in a local config file. The model never sees them. Signing happens on your machine. Why that design matters, and where the remaining risk actually sits.
 How people are using it. Research and market analysis, monitoring, strategy testing in demo mode, and execution. Where each one genuinely helps, and where it falls apart.
 The part nobody wants to say out loud. AI makes mistakes, and you own the losses. What guardrails look like in practice - read-only mode, demo profiles, permission-scoped keys - and why you should never skip them.
 Where the edge goes. When every desk can run the same agent on the same public data, what's actually left worth having.
 Then we build one, live
 Last fifteen minutes: a working agent wired to OKX through Claude Code, pulling live market data, running in read-only mode. From nothing to working, on stage. No laptops needed - just watch how little it takes.

name: Collaborative Agent Hackathon @ Stanford
description:
Build open agents that work together
 The Collaborative Agent Hackathon is a one-day event for building open-source, collaborative AI agents using Flower.
 Agents are changing what is possible, and their greatest potential emerges when they collaborate safely in human-supervised multi-agent teams.
 Participants will form teams on the day, develop a working prototype and present it at the end of the event. Each team will explore how open-source collaborative agents of varying complexity can work together safely.
 You do not need an existing team or a fully developed idea. Bring your laptop, your interests and a willingness to collaborate.
 The hackathon challenge
 Build an open-source agent or multi-agent system using Flower in which the safe collaboration of agent teams is central to the solution.
 Projects can range across the full collaborative spectrum. Multiple agents might:
 Automate a task

 Form self-improving loops with one another

 Operate across distributed machines and datasets

 Flower is built together with an open-source community spanning more than 7k users world-wide. Flower simplifies building multi-agent systems, supporting distributed coordination, collaborative learning and inference, and privacy-aware deployment.

 Token Sale setup for 2026, including round structure (private to public route), tokenomics, whitepaper, legal framework and more

 Choosing, and getting selected for, the right launchpads and platforms under today's stricter vetting and compliance

name: [Altus X Decipher] Career Meet-up: The First Penguin
description:
이벤트 소개
 디지털자산 인프라 기업 Altus(구 B-Harvest)와 서울대학교 블록체인 학회 Decipher가 2026 KBW 기간에 함께 개최하는 커리어 밋업 행사, The First Penguin입니다. 블록체인은 Web3의 실험적 단계를 넘어, 이제는 전통 금융 인프라를 교체하는 단계로 본격 진입하고 있습니다. Altus와 Decipher 역시 이러한 변화 속에서, 금융기관이 디지털자산과 블록체인 기술을 실제 비즈니스와 인프라에 적용하는 영역에 집중하고 있습니다.
 The First Penguin은 무리에서 가장 먼저 바다에 뛰어드는 첫 번째 펭귄처럼, 이러한 변화의 흐름에 먼저 뛰어들 분들을 위한 자리입니다.
 금융권 현직 실무자들과 함께 금융기관의 블록체인 도입과 변화를 살펴보고, Altus 현직자들의 실제 업무와 Decipher 학회원들의 커리어 경험을 들어볼 수 있습니다. 행사 후반에는 Altus의 직무 소개와 지원 안내가 이어집니다.
 어떤 분들을 위한 자리일까요?
 디지털자산 인프라에 관심이 있으신 분 금융기관이 블록체인을 실제로 어떻게 검토하고 도입하는지 현직자의 목소리로 확인하실 수 있습니다.

 능동적으로 커리어를 도약시키고 싶은 분 금융과 블록체인이 만나는 영역에서 어떤 직무와 기회가 만들어지고 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.

 금융,핀테크 등 기존 산업에서 디지털자산 분야로 커리어 전환을 희망하시는 분 주니어부터 시니어까지, 먼저 해당 커리어를 쌓고 있는 현직자의 경험을 들으실 수 있습니다.

 Altus와 Decipher에 관심이 있으신 분 어떤 일을 하고 어떤 사람들과 함께하고자 하는지 알아가실 수 있습니다.

 시간 및 장소
 일시: 2026년 9월 30일 수요일 | 18:00 - 22:00

 장소: 서울 (정확한 위치는 승인 후 공개됩니다)

 인원: 최대 100명

 진행 세션
 모든 세션은 한국어로 진행됩니다.
 참가자 등록 및 아이스브레이킹 (1시간 | 18:00 - 19:00)

 Decipher 소개 | Decipher 학회장 이영제 (5분 | 19:00 - 19:05)

 오프닝 키노트 | Altus 대표 이형연 (5분 | 19:05 - 19:10)

 Altus 패널 토크 | 금융권 블록체인, 검토에서 도입으로 (40분 | 19:10 - 19:50 | 한국은행, KODA, 미래에셋 등 현직자가 패널로 참여)

 Decipher 패널 토크 | 주니어들이 들려주는 블록체인 커리어 이야기 (20분 | 19:50 - 20:10)

 Decipher 학회 우수팀 발표 | 토큰화증권 구멍가게 (10분 | 20:10 - 20:20)

 Altus 소개 | 회사, 직무, 그리고 지원 안내 (40분 | 20:20 - 21:00)

 자유 네트워킹 (1시간 | 21:00 - 22:00)

 About Altus
 Altus(구 B-Harvest)는 2018년 설립된 블록체인 금융 인프라 개발사입니다. 지난 8년간 국내외 금융기관과 블록체인 프로젝트를 위한 네트워크, 코어 프로토콜, 결제 및 RWA 토큰화 인프라를 구축해 왔습니다.
 Altus의 미션은 기관의 디지털 자산 전략을 실제 운영 가능한 금융 시스템과 사업으로 구현하는 것입니다. 이를 위해 FDE(Forward-Deployed Engineer) 방식으로 고객 조직과 긴밀하게 협력하며, 문제 정의와 기술 전략 수립부터 아키텍처 설계, 코어 프로토콜 개발, 인프라 구축과 운영까지 전 과정을 수행합니다.

 스탠드엑스(StandX)

Official Channel on X

name: RealFi x Asia Stablecoin Conference
description:
Title Sponsor: Ant Digital, S&P Global
 Co-Hosts: Pharos Network, Four Pillars, LayerZero
 Organizer: Asia Stablecoin Alliance, The Capital Summit
 Understand the Diverse Asia
 Asia is not a single market.
 Korea, Japan, Hong Kong, Singapore, Southeast Asia, the UAE, and other markets are each developing their own approach to stablecoins, tokenization, digital money, and financial infrastructure. These approaches are shaped by different regulations, institutions, currencies, payment needs, and capital market structures.
 That's why ASA Conference 2026 is returning to Seoul on October 1, 2026 to bring these conversations into one dedicated forum!
 In 2025, ASA Conference brought together 700+ builders, issuers, institutions, infrastructure providers, researchers, and policymakers in Seoul. Across 17 sessions, teams including LayerZero, Ethena, Wyoming Stable Token, Canton, Securitize, and Plume explored how Asian stablecoins could move from concept to adoption.
 This year's conference goes deeper by moving from the big picture to the market level. ASA Conference 2026 will look at each market on its own terms, examining the issuers, distributors, institutions, use cases, and infrastructure shaping how new forms of money move across Asia.

 현장에 별도의 주차 공간은 제공되지 않으니 방문 계획 시 참고해 주세요.
 최신 소식은 X 에서 BNB 체인 계정을 통해서 확인해보세요.

description:

 Enter the Night
 9월 한 달간 진행된 Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026 의 결과물이 Korea Blockchain Week 기간 서울에서 공개됩니다.
 해커톤 우승 3팀의 라이브 데모부터 프라이버시와 보안을 둘러싼 기관 세션, 그리고 빌더-기업-투자자-커뮤니티가 함께하는 네트워킹까지.
 Enter the Night 은 한 달간의 빌드를 마무리하고, 프라이버시 기술을 만들고 활용하는 사람들이 한자리에 모이는 Korea Blockchain Week 2026 사이드 이벤트 입니다.

 행사 개요
 일시
 2026년 10월 2일 금요일 - 17:00-20:00 KST

 장소
 승인된 참석자에 한해 안내드릴 예정입니다.

 행사 구성
 해커톤 데모데이

 프로젝트, 기관 세션 (Midnight, CertiK, SFL)

 커뮤니티 네트워킹

 정원: 100명
 *행사는 Korea Blockchain Week 2026 기간인 10월 2일 금요일 개최되며, 승인 후 참석이 확정됩니다.
 한 달간의 빌드, 수상팀의 프로젝트가 공개됩니다
 9월 한 달 동안 참가 팀들은 4주간의 온라인 해커톤을 통해 Midnight 위에서 프라이버시 중심 DApp을 만들었습니다.
 Enter the Night은 그 과정의 결과물이 공개되는 자리입니다. 최종 선정된 우승 3팀이 직접 무대에 올라 무엇을 만들었고, 어떤 문제를 풀고자 했는지 보여줍니다.
 그리고 그 결과물을 중심으로 프라이버시 기술을 만드는 빌더, 이를 검토하고 도입하는 기업과 기관, 투자자와 Web3 커뮤니티가 한 공간에서 만납니다.
 개발자나 해커톤 참가자가 아니어도 참석할 수 있습니다.
 행사는 어떻게 진행되나요?
 Demo Day
 Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026 우승 3팀 이 직접 무대에 올라 프로젝트를 소개하고 라이브 데모를 선보입니다.

 한 달간의 빌드가 실제 제품과 아이디어로 어떻게 이어졌는지 만나보세요.

 Privacy, Security & Institutional Perspectives
 Midnight과 CertiK 이 프라이버시, 보안, 그리고 기술의 실제 도입 가능성을 각자의 관점에서 이야기합니다.

 빌더가 만들어낸 결과물과 보안-기관 생태계의 시각을 한자리에서 연결합니다.

 Community Networking
 데모와 세션 이후에는 빌더, 창업자, 기업-기관 관계자, 투자자, 미디어와 Web3 커뮤니티가 자유롭게 교류합니다.

 새로운 프로젝트를 발견하고, 협업 가능성을 찾고, KBW의 밤을 이어가세요.

 이런 분들을 만날 수 있습니다
 금융기관 및 엔터프라이즈 관계자

 Web3 창업자 및 생태계 팀

 프라이버시-ZK 기술을 다루는 빌더

 투자자 및 생태계 파트너

 미디어 및 Web3 커뮤니티

 우승 팀 소개
 Midnight Korea Hackathon 2026의 최종 심사를 통해 선정된 우승 3팀 이 Enter the Night 무대에 오릅니다.
 팀과 프로젝트는 최종 결과 발표 후 공개됩니다.

name: XRPfi Night Seoul
description:
XRPfi Night Seoul
 *English event details are provided below the Korean description 본 행사는 단순한 네트워킹 모임이 아닌, XRPfi를 깊이 있게 배우는 '교육 중심(Educational Focus)' 행사입니다. 본 이벤트는 실제 XRP를 보유하고 있으며, 온체인 활용법과 XRPfi 생태계를 진정성 있게 공부하고자 하는 실제 XRP 홀더분들만 신청 및 참석이 가능 합니다. XRPfi에 대해 배우고 실질적인 지식을 얻어가고자 하는 분들만 등록을 진행해 주시길 부탁드립니다.
 국내외 XRP 커뮤니티와 XRPfi 프로젝트를 서울에서 만나보세요
 DCENT가 주최하는 XRP Seoul 2026 공식 사이드 이벤트, XRPfi Night Seoul에 여러분을 초대합니다. Korea Blockchain Week 2026 기간 중, XRP Seoul 본 행사 전날 밤에 열립니다.
 XRPL EU, XRPL Japan을 비롯해 XRP Seoul 위크를 위해 서울을 찾은 글로벌 XRPL 커뮤니티와 국내 XRP 홀더들 한자리에 모입니다. XRPL 위에서 실제 서비스를 만들고 있는 팀들의 세션을 듣고, 부스에서 XRPfi를 직접 경험하며, 같은 자산을 보유한 분들과 이야기 나누는 자리입니다.
 XRP를 보유하고 계시지만 온체인에서 무엇을 할 수 있는지 아직 확인해 보지 못하셨다면, 이 밤에서 그 답을 찾아보세요.
 행사 정보
 일시: 2026년 10월 2일(금) 오후 5시 ~ 9시

 장소: 등록 후 확인 가능

 주최: DCENT

 스폰서: Flare - SOIL - t54 - Santiment - SIVAX

 진행 언어: 한국어 중심, 영어 별도

 본 행사는 승인제로 운영됩니다. 참석 확정 여부는 별도 안내되며 승인된 참석자에 한해 입장 가능합니다.
 이런 행사에서 만나볼 이야기
 XRPfi의 다음 단계
 결제와 토큰화 자산, 온체인 금융이 XRP 위에서 만나고 있습니다. 볼트와 스왑, AI 기반 도구까지 확장되고 있는 XRPfi 생태계의 방향을 직접 만들고 있는 팀들이 설명해 드립니다.
 지금 바로 활용 가능한 것들
 보유 중인 XRP를 온체인에서 운용하는 방법, XRP 위에서 자산을 전송하고 교환하는 방법, 자동화와 AI를 활용한 차세대 도구까지 실질적인 활용 사례를 확인하실 수 있습니다.
 부스에서의 직접 경험
 행사 내내 운영되는 파트너 부스에서 첫 예치 과정을 처음부터 함께 진행해 보고, 데모 키오스크에서 제품을 직접 사용해 보실 수 있습니다. 각 프로젝트 팀에게 궁금한 점을 바로 질문하실 수 있으며, 굿즈와 이벤트도 준비되어 있습니다.

name: Monad Metropolis Hacker House: London
description:
Monad Metropolis is Monad's flagship global hackathon - six weeks, online-first, $250,000 in prizes. This is the London hacker house: one day at Encode Hub to meet other builders working on Metropolis, get your questions answered, and put real hours into your submission.
 Metropolis runs 1 September to 13 October. Wherever you are in that window - still shaping an idea, looking for teammates, or deep in the build - this day is for you.
 What to expect
 Morning: around two hours of talks and workshops. A technical session run by Monad's engineering team, plus speakers on the things that decide whether a hackathon project becomes a company - go-to-market, fundraising, business model, community and hiring.
 Rest of the day: coworking. Desks, fast wifi, coffee, and mentors on the floor.
Come with a team or find one here.
 The Tracks
 Onchain Finance & Trading - asset primitives and market infrastructure that only work with fast settlement.
 Consumer Products & Payments - crypto that doesn't feel like crypto. Social payments, salary streaming, programmable gifts.
 Social, Attention & Culture - open social graphs, attention markets, generative art, competitive feeds.
 Trust, Identity & AI Infrastructure - primitives for an AI-native internet. Proof of personhood, content passports, data lockers.
 Prizes
 $250,000 total. $30,000 overall winner, $30,000 per track, plus 20+ sponsor bounties from Dynamic, Privy, Perpl, Nansen, Chainlink, Agora, Kuru, MetaMask and others.
 Who should come
 Developers, designers and founders building on Monad - or curious about it. Solo builders welcome; teams form on the day. You don't need prior Monad experience, but bring a laptop.
 Registration is free and capacity is limited.

name: [Lambda256] Join the Blockchain Node Crew
description:
이벤트 소개
 본격적으로 금융과 맞물리기 시작한 블록체인. 결제, 자산 토큰화(RWA), 거래소 인프라까지 현재 일어나는 모든 블록체인X금융 사업의 선두에 람다256이 있습니다. 어디에서도 들을 수 없는, 저희가 직접 보고 겪은 금융 시장 최전선의 이야기를 나누고자 합니다.
 이번에 람다256에서 소개할 노드 운영 직군 은 블록체인 네트워크에 직접 연결되는 서버를 구축하고 운영하며, 블록체인 인프라의 안정적인 운영을 책임지는 핵심 역할입니다. 그동안은 소수의 인프라 조직이 담당해왔지만, 국내 금융업계에서 디지털 자산 기술 검증(PoC)이 본격화되면서, 이제는 금융권 수준의 안정성과 데이터 정합성까지 요구되고 있습니다. 블록체인과 금융의 접점이 넓어질수록, 안정적인 네트워크 운영을 책임지는 노드 운영의 중요성도 더욱 커지고 있습니다. 신입 크루를 모시기에 앞서, 이러한 변화 속에서 노드 운영이 실제로 어떤 일을 하는지, 그리고 그 역할이 왜 중요한지 소개하는 자리를 마련했습니다. 현직자의 이야기와 라이브 데모를 통해 실제 업무와 현장을 가까이에서 경험하실 수 있습니다.
 이런 분께 권해드립니다
 블록체인 인프라가 실제로 어떻게 운영되는지, 그 구조와 원리를 이해하고 싶은 분

 애플리케이션 개발을 넘어, 시스템을 안정적으로 운영하는 영역에 관심 있는 분

 금융과 블록체인이 결합되는 흐름 속에서 커리어의 방향을 탐색 중인 분

 노드 운영 직무로 첫 커리어를 시작하고자 하는 대학생-졸업예정자-주니어 개발자

 프로그램 안내
 16:00 - 16:30 ㅣ 방문접수 - 굿즈 수령 16:30 - 16:40 ㅣ Welcome Speech
 람다256과 노딧(Nodit) 소개 - 남기훈, 람다256 CTO

 16:40 - 17:10 ㅣKeynote
 금융과 블록체인이 만나는 현장, 그 최전선의 이야기 - 박수빈, 람다256 B2B 기술 영업 리드

 17:10 - 17:30 ㅣNode Operation Session
 노드 운영이 하는 일 - 팀 소개 & 라이브 데모 - 정준호, 람다256 노드운영팀

 17:30 - 18:00 ㅣMentoring and Q&A
 현장 멘토링 및 질의응답 - 람다256 노드운영팀

 18:00 - 19:00 ㅣ채용 안내 & 마무리 네트워킹
 세션별 시간은 현장 상황에 따라 일부 조정될 수 있습니다.
 이벤트 장소
 업비트 라운지(Upbit Lounge) - 서울 강남역 인근 소재

 접수 안내

 A focused, invite-only gathering for the researchers, founders, and protocol teams shaping the next era of onchain finance, at a moment when attackers have started turning to AI and defense must move from "tested" to "proven."
 This session examines a shift already underway. As stablecoins mature into payment rails and RWAs bring real-world value onchain, the value at stake has surged, while AI is making attacks faster, cheaper, and harder to anticipate. Drawing on real exploit investigations and deep security experience across DeFi, stablecoin, and RWA protocols, the conversation centers on what provable security actually looks like when the threat itself becomes intelligent.
 Rather than a one-way panel, this is built for genuine exchange among people solving the same problems. Discussions are structured, candid, and grounded in real systems, giving technical and business leaders room to challenge assumptions, compare defensive approaches, and engage directly with leading researchers and peers navigating the same frontier.
 What to Expect
 Honest discussion on how AI is reshaping both attack and defence across onchain finance.
 Deep dives into recent exploits, failure modes, and the patterns behind them.
 A practical look at formal verification, and why provable security is becoming the standard for stablecoins, RWAs, and institutional-grade protocols.
 Who Should Attend
 Founders - CTOs - Stablecoin & RWA Teams - Protocol Architects - Security Researchers - Auditors - Institutional & DeFi Builders

name: Cardano Node Diversity Celebration Day
description:
One network. Many builders. A stronger future. Cardano node diversity is no longer just an ambition. It is becoming real. On the 6th October in Singapore, Cardano Diversity Celebration Day will bring together representatives from Cardano's different node implementations to share their progress, compare timelines and discuss how independent implementations can strengthen the network. The event will also introduce the Diversity Ambassador Program and invite feedback on the next phase of this collective effort. Why does this matter? Because a truly resilient blockchain should never depend on one team, one codebase or one way of solving a problem. Independent node implementations give Cardano more protection, more opportunities for innovation and more freedom to evolve. Node diversity reduces common-mode risk: when implementations are developed independently, they can reveal different edge cases, validate protocol behaviour from different perspectives. It also creates room for improvements in resource efficiency, observability, tooling and operator experience. This is not about replacing one implementation with another. It is about building complementary infrastructure - giving Cardano more resilience, more engineering options and greater confidence as the protocol evolves. Cardano Diversity Celebration Day is where the people building that future come together and where the wider community gets to see what comes next
 The event will be broadcasted from Singapore but everyone is welcome to join us online.

name: TOKEN2049 Week Side Event, Singapore. 🇸🇬 Quantum Security for Digital Assets, Industry Leaders, Networking, Food & Beverages.
description:
Quantum Security for Digital Assets

This private technical event brings together industry leaders, protocol engineers, cryptography researchers, digital asset specialists and institutional stakeholders to examine the emerging security requirements of digital assets in a post quantum environment.

The discussion will focus on the cryptographic foundations required to protect digital asset infrastructure as quantum computing develops, including digital signatures, transaction authentication, identity, key management, consensus security and the protection of blockchain execution environments.

Panels with industry leaders will be followed by relaxed networking with senior peers over food and drinks.

Particular attention will be given to the transition from conventional elliptic curve cryptography toward post quantum cryptographic systems and the practical considerations involved in implementing these mechanisms at protocol level.

Topics will include

Post quantum digital signatures and transaction authentication

Quantum resistant identity and account structures

Key generation, address derivation and key lifecycle management

Post quantum consensus and validator communication

Cryptographic verification within distributed systems

Quantum resistant smart contract infrastructure

Migration considerations for existing digital asset systems

Security implications for institutional digital asset custody and infrastructure.

The discussion will also examine how post quantum cryptography can be integrated throughout a blockchain protocol rather than being implemented as an isolated security layer.

Quantova will present its approach to post quantum blockchain architecture, including the Quantova Virtual Machine and its implementation of PQR cryptographic primitives across transaction signing, account creation, consensus and execution.

Attendees will have the opportunity to examine the practical relationship between cryptographic primitives, protocol architecture and application execution, with discussion focused on implementation rather than commercial promotion.

About organizers:

Quantova runs a post-quantum Layer 1 network built from first principles to issue, move, settle and protect digital value: digital identity, stablecoins, tokenised real-world assets, payments and institutional settlement, without inheriting a future migration burden.

Quantova launched QDock.io, the development environment supporting post quantum application development, together with the underlying cryptographic libraries, compilation tooling and deployment infrastructure used within the Quantova environment.

Further technical information is available at Quantova.org

HackenProof is a bug bounty and crowdsourced security platform connecting companies with a global network of white-hat security researchers. The platform supports more than 400 programs, with over $26 million paid in bounties and a community of more than 85,000 ethical hackers.

Anna Tutova has been active in the digital asset industry for many years, working at the intersection of cryptocurrency regulation, institutional finance and quantum security.  DK Bank - the harbour. The official bank of Bhutan's Gelephu Mindfulness City, built for digital assets from day one.

 Cloudflare - the lanes. The network it all runs over, reaching 95% of the world's internet users in roughly 50 milliseconds.

 VerifyVASP - the manifest. Travel Rule at institutional scale: who is on the other end, verified before the value moves.

 Five claims, and every one of them checkable.

 20:00-20:20 嘉宾入场、欢迎酒与自由交流 2

 20:55-21:50 现场表演与自由交流、社交

 现场嘉宾
 RWA 与 Web3 项目的创始人及联合创始人、生态与增长负责人、交易平台及金融基础设施团队、BiFu 合作伙伴、KOL 与内容创作者、专业社群主理人，以及媒体、研究者、投资机构和新加坡 FinTech／Web3 生态参与者。
 主办方｜Host：BiFu
 成立于 2023 年，BiFu 是融通 Web2 与 Web3 全域资产交易的先锋级平台。
 BiFu 是连接数字资产与更广泛全球市场的统一资产网络。我们打破传统金融边界，让用户只需一个账户，即可自由交易 Crypto、外汇、大宗商品、美港股及 RWA。凭借统一账户体系、极速稳定性能、完备合规与社区赋能，BiFu 致力于让全球优质财富走向平权，确保无论机会出现在哪个市场，用户都已「在场」。
 关于 BiNet｜全域资产交易网络
 BiNet 是 BiFu 打造的全域资产交易网络，也是 「One Account, Trade the World」 这句承诺的底层支撑。
 它将加密资产、外汇、大宗商品、股票、RWA 与预测市场六大类市场整合进统一账户体系。用户只需完成一次身份认证，即可用同一个账户、同一笔资金进入全部市场。
 在这套体系之下，BiNet 以统一身份、统一资金、统一风控、统一合规四项基础能力为骨架，辅以聚合 200 余家全球交易所的流动性网络、亚毫秒级交易引擎与智能路由，让跨市场交易像在单一市场中一样连贯、顺畅。
 资产之间的墙正在被拆除， BiNet 要做的，就是把全球市场装进一个账户。
 关于 BiFu 财富板块｜BiFu Wealth
 RWA 的价值不只在于资产上链，更在于让普通投资者真正有机会参与其中。
 BiFu 财富板块面向既有稳健收益诉求、又希望保留资金灵活性的用户，提供一站式资产配置入口。依托 BiNet 的统一账户与跨市场基础设施，RWA 将与加密资产、外汇、大宗商品共同构成多元资产配置体系。
 通过将真实世界资产引入链上配置框架，财富板块让过去仅向机构开放的收益来源，逐步成为普通投资者可触达、可理解、可配置的选项。
 让 RWA 从行业热词变成普通投资者账户里的真实持仓，这是 BiFu 财富板块对「金融平权」的回答，也是我们对「RWA 真正落地」这个命题给出的实践。
 RWA Beyond the Hype: What Will Real Adoption Take?
 RWA no longer lacks attention. The more important question now is how real-world assets can become products that users understand, trust, and choose to use - and how those products can reach meaningful scale.

For the people who run finance, this is no longer a topic to watch. It is a set of decisions to make.

 Stablecoins as treasury and settlement infrastructure, and what regulatory clarity now allows

name: The Institutional Table: Private Dinner on Tokenization, Stablecoins and Se
description:
21 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.
 The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the closing night of Token2049 Singapore. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, custodians, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.
 What we will talk about
 Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or money market structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them. Lessons from Project Guardian pilots going to production.
 Stablecoins as payment rails: MAS-regulated issuance, reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited.
 The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response.
 What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier.
 Format
 Seated dinner for 21. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides.
 Who is at the table
 Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.
 Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in the Marina Bay area, shared with confirmed guests.
 About QuillAudits
 8+ years securing Web3.

name: XRP LEDGER HACKATHON
description:
Sprint, build, and launch on the XRP Ledger in 36 hours in New York City, the weekend before Swell.
 Hosted by XRPL Commons, this hackathon brings hackers into the room where the ecosystem's institutions, investors, and decision-makers are already gathered - with a project and a story to tell. Whether this is your first commit on XRP Ledger or you've been building for years, there's a track for you.
 4 Tracks
 Protocol Innovation : work on the ledger itself: amendments, client implementations, tooling. Paired with a 3-day Core Dev Bootcamp (Oct 20-22) as your on-ramp.

 Agentic Finance : build the rails that let autonomous agents transact on-chain safely and at machine speed.

 Lending & Borrowing : build on top of the XRP Ledger Lending Protocol (XLS-66) and Single Asset Vaults (XLS-65), currently in validator voting.

 Why Not : the open lane, for whatever XRP Ledger project you can't stop thinking about.

 Already Building?
 Bring an existing project - on XRP Ledger or elsewhere - and use the 36 hours to add XRPL rails or ship a new feature. Only what you build during the hackathon counts toward judging.
 Registration details

name: Bay Area AI+car hackathon
description: Car AI Navigation Hackathon Challenge: We have a mini city road with lanes, intersection and traffic signs. Your job is to use AI and a small autonomous car like the Donkeycar or equivalent (typically 1/16th scale or smaller RC car with a Raspberry Pi or equivalent and a camera controlling it) to navigate the "city", obeying signs and making it from one side to the other in the fastest time. You must bring your own car, which should be ready to run, with compute and camera already onboard and working. The objective of the hackathon is to add AI "city" navigation to it. You can use onboard AI, AI on your laptop via Wifi or AI in the cloud to help with the navigation. Think creatively about what kind of AI to use and what's the fastest way to do it! This is not an event for spectators, nor will cars be provided to those who arrive without one. This is a hackathon, not a regular race. Come ready to hack!

Expect a highly collaborative residency with sessions, workshops, demos, open discussions, and hands-on building time.

Learn what's happening at the frontiers of Bitcoin OSS development and design

name: The Institutional Table: Private Dinner on Tokenization, Stablecoins and Security
description:
41 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.
 The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the evening IBW closes and the night before Devcon opens. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.
 What we will talk about
 Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or real estate structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them.
 Stablecoins as payment rails: reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited.
 The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response.
 What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier.
 Format
 Seated dinner for 41. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides.
 Who is at the table
 Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.
 Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in BKC, Mumbai, shared with confirmed guests.
 About QuillAudits
 8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed.

name: Ship Safe: Devcon Mumbai Security Sessions
description:
Last day of Devcon. Before you head to the closing party, spend one session on the thing that decides whether what you shipped this week survives contact with mainnet.
 Ship Safe is QuillAudits' security session for Devcon Mumbai: real exploit teardowns, a practical audit-readiness clinic, and a panel on what actually broke in 2026 and why. Short talks, hard questions, then drinks.
 What to expect
 Exploit teardowns: we walk through the biggest 2026 incidents line by line. Where the bug was, why the audit missed it, what the fix looked like.
 Audit readiness: how to prepare a codebase so an audit finds real issues instead of formatting nits. Scoping, invariants, test coverage, what to freeze before review.
 AI vs AI: how attackers are using AI to find bugs faster, and what AI-assisted auditing and formal verification change for teams shipping on tight timelines.
 Panel: founders, auditors and researchers on the security debt building up across L2s, RWA and stablecoin rails, and what they would do differently.
 Networking and drinks from 6:45 PM.
 Who should come
 Founders, CTOs and protocol engineers shipping on Ethereum and L2s. Security researchers and auditors. RWA, stablecoin and DeFi teams. Anyone who wants an honest look at how things break.
 About QuillAudits
 8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed, trusted by teams including StarkWare, Taiko, ZetaChain and Metis. Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

 The Solana Foundation is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.
 About Lukka
 Lukka is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets.
 About Breezing
 Breezing is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand.
 Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital, BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune.

name: University Blockchain Conference 2026
description:
UBC: Where Talent Meets Opportunity
 The University Blockchain Conference (UBC) - formerly the Midwest Blockchain Conference - is the leading access point connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry across the U.S. and beyond. What started in the heartland of Ann Arbor has grown into a national movement and global network, now spanning 100+ universities including schools in South America and Europe. This year, we're evolving - new name, new home, same mission.
 Built by students for students, UBC brings together university clubs, high schools, alumni, and industry leaders, all focused on pushing crypto forward through student leadership.
 Connecting Top Talent with Leading Companies
 If you're a student or faculty member passionate about blockchain, this is your gateway. This November, connect with dozens of hiring companies, VCs eager to invest, and thought leaders excited to share knowledge with the next generation of builders.
 If you're an industry professional, UBC offers unmatched exposure to over 1000+ ambitious students and dozens of elite university programs, many of which have traditionally been difficult to reach. Grow your user base, recruit standout talent, and shape the future of the space.
 Bigger Than Ever - Real Outcomes UBC 2026 is set to surpass every prior year in every dimension: More speakers. More sponsors. More opportunities. And it's working. Past attendees landed roles at: Coinbase, Circle, Gemini, Galaxy, Polymarket, and many leading companies in blockchain, fintech, and policy.
 This year, expect world-class speakers from industry and government, a major hackathon and research competition, tons of networking opportunities, massive side events, and as always, fire merch.
